name: grp-mcp
description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude: read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across the five APIs Acumatica actually has. Talks to your own instance directly - nothing is proxied, and credentials never leave your machine. Writes are off per profile until you enable them, and a clean 'ok' is never trusted: writes are read back and anything unconfirmed is reported as unverified. Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux from PyPI through uvx, so it needs uv installed - 'winget install astral-sh.uv' on Windows, 'brew install uv' on a Mac. Run tools\Edit-Connections.cmd once to create your connections file; it lands in %USERPROFILE%\grp-mcp (~/.grp-mcp on macOS and Linux), outside AppData where a Claude app update cannot delete it, and the server finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.0-rc24): workgroups can be reordered within their branch. Moving one up or down among its siblings changes only the display order, never who its parent is. Asking to move further than there is room moves it as far as it can go and tells you so, instead of reporting a move that did not happen - at the top or bottom the screen accepts the click and silently does nothing. With rc23's move, the Company Tree can now be built, staffed, rearranged and taken apart without opening the screen. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
